Why “Not Done” Can Feel More Actionable――「やること」より「できてないこと」を見る

「本を読む」「部屋を片付ける」とToDoにすると動きにくいのに、‘I have a book I haven’t read’ ‘My room is still not tidy’ と現在の未完了として見ると、なぜか優先順位が見えやすい。Research on self-regulation, progress monitoring, self-concordance, and unfinished tasks suggests a smaller idea: Not Done is not magic motivation. It may work as a map of the gap between current state and desired state, helping us notice which gaps are actually ours.
